items.title: Mistral open-sourced its trillion-parameter flagship
items.oneliner: Mistral released Large 4 weights at 1T parameters. Open multimodal models just got much harder to dismiss.

items.title: Qwen now hides a CPU in weights
items.oneliner: Qwenputer embeds a deterministic RISC-V CPU inside Qwen 3.5. Model weights are starting to look like runtime.

items.title: New York restricted AI chatbots for minors
items.oneliner: New York banned child-facing chatbots from impersonation, secret-keeping, and self-harm prompts. Product safety rules now have teeth.

items.title: Azure cross-tenant compromise exposed cloud trust
items.oneliner: Researchers detail five Azure cross-tenant compromises via Logic Apps. Shared cloud control planes remain a catastrophic blast radius.

items.title: A single SMS can crash Android phones
items.oneliner: A malformed WAP Push SMS can silently crash Android telephony and drop calls. Zero-click mobile DoS is still here.

items.title: PAN-OS exploit chain rooted government servers
items.oneliner: A chained PAN-OS exploit reportedly rooted 25 servers, including US government systems. Exposed management planes remain indefensible.

items.title: Grace Blackwell needs rack-aware scheduling
items.oneliner: SkyPilot says rack-aware scheduling unlocks 27% more usable GPUs on NVL72. Cluster software is now a hardware multiplier.

items.title: Go gets a zero-allocation enforcement tool
items.oneliner: noalloc checks whole Go call trees for heap allocations. Performance-sensitive teams can finally gate memory regressions in CI.

items.title: Stack Overflow usage keeps collapsing
items.oneliner: Stack Overflow fell below 1,000 monthly questions. Developer help has decisively shifted from forums to assistants.

items.title: DoorDash moved to buy Instacart
items.oneliner: DoorDash plans to buy Instacart for about $17 billion. Delivery platforms are consolidating around logistics and retail data.
